description: List recorded restart incidents, newest first. Captured logs are excluded unless include_logs is set, because every incident carries a hundred lines of output twice over

include_logs.description: Include the logs captured before and after each restart (default: false)

limit.description: Most recent N incidents (default: 10, 0 for all)

server.description: Remote server name from config (optional, runs locally if omitted)

name: watch_history
